body.text: EXTREME COMMUNICATION CONTRACT: use one future physical occurrence as a shared rendezvous object instead of exchanging status prose. Producer epoch publishes only the canonical occurrence/ref set plus an executable probe. A second epoch receives that key and derives the object through a different fabric. A third independent epoch tries to falsify identity/cardinality/evidence or retry semantics. external-chatgpt then receives the sanitized refs and returns review_result/counterexample. If all paths converge, broadcast the invariant as a regression fence; if any disagree, emit trace_divergence and reconcile before further promotion. Apply this first to the next live Codex provider attempt and to the selected real named native Power. Do not create a new supervisor, ledger, RPC service, chat protocol, or shadow state—the current remote-mesh, WorkGraph, canonical ledger, shell, and evidence owners are the medium.

subject: Communication by shared reality: future occurrence becomes the rendezvous object
